# CUDA 13.2 / torch 2.11+cu130 / triton 3.6.0 dep set.
# Includes official DeepEP main@a56d6156 built against NCCL 2.30.4 and
# NVSHMEM 3.5.19, plus FlashInfer 0.6.12.
# FlashAttention 3 remains deferred.

# Core torch stack — wheels mirrored to OSS by us; upstream is
# https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130/.

torchvision==0.26.0+cu130
nvidia-nccl-cu13==2.30.4
nvidia-nvshmem-cu13==3.5.19
nvidia-cuda-cccl==13.2.86

# Triton 3.6.0 supports CUDA 13.x ptxas natively (no wrapper needed).
triton==3.6.0

# FlashInfer Python and cubins use the same validated release.
flashinfer-python @ https://rtp-maga.oss-cn-zhangjiakou.aliyuncs.com/rtp-kernel/rtp_kernel_260608/flashinfer_python-0.6.12-py3-none-any.whl
flashinfer-cubin @ https://rtp-maga.oss-cn-zhangjiakou.aliyuncs.com/rtp-kernel/rtp_kernel_260608/flashinfer_cubin-0.6.12-py3-none-any.whl

# Hadamard transform used by the GLM5 indexer.
fast-hadamard-transform @ https://rtp-maga.oss-cn-zhangjiakou.aliyuncs.com/whls/fast_hadamard/fast_hadamard_transform-1.1.0-cp310-cp310-linux_x86_64.whl
# Upstream v2.8.3.post1@a8aa52b1 with CUTLASS dc481792, rebuilt for CUDA 13.2.
flash-attn==2.8.3.post1+cu13torch2.11cxx11abitrue.r1

# Wheels built against torch 2.11+cu130.
# Preserve the GLM5 kernel versions used by the validated inference path.

# Official DeepEP main@a56d6156 with legacy Buffer and V2 APIs.

# DSV4 mHC uses TileLang by default.  Keep the same version as cuda12_9.

# Unified rtp_kernel built from cuda_extension feat/port-nvfp4-xqa@94fd20eb
# against torch 2.11+cu130; NVFP4 mm only (no XQA wrappers).

# fastsafetensors / fast_safetensors rebuilt against torch 2.11+cu130
# (originals were torch 2.1.2 + cu121).  Project name is `fast-safetensors`

# fast_safetensors rebuilt against torch 2.11+cu130.

# Pin safetensors and tabulate for parity with cu12_9 lock.

mysql-connector-python

# autoawq / auto_gptq / bitsandbytes / peft are torch-ABI-bound; pip will
